title: Regional revenue is inflated and new customers' orders are missing
issue: Finance reports that daily revenue on the regional dashboard is higher than the billing system, and orders from brand-new customers are missing entirely. `raw_customers` keeps one row per customer change (history); a customer must be counted under their most recent region by `updated_at`. Orders whose customer is not in `raw_customers` must still be counted, under region 'unknown'. `revenue` is rounded to 2 decimals and `orders` is the order count.
